blend.note: a NEW emergent culture, neither Greek nor Plains - Hellenic horse-lords of the open grassland, mystery-cults and vision-quests, the war-band and the polis-of-tents; the tongue, titles and gods are fused forms (Greek -os/-on + Plains -wi/descriptive deed-names).

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Greek + Plains): a single emergent people of the grass-sea - mounted war-clans who wed the Hellenic mystery-cult and bronze-panoply to the Plains vision-quest and horse-raid. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused (Greek th/ph/kh/-os + Plains open vowels/-wi). clan = clanhold. Seeds/shifts Lawful or Chaotic (the ordered war-host vs the raid-frenzy). Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Greek/Plains registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods.

phonology.palette: Fused Hellenic-Plains: Greek aspirates th/ph/kh and -os/-on/-es meet Plains open vowels and -wi/-ta; consonants p t k s sh h m n w y r l, glottal stop; fused endings -ios/-wios/-os on open Plains roots.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; Greek clusters (kt/st/ph) soften toward Plains open vowels; -ios/-wi endings.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ides (Greek) fused with the band-name (genolowa); a deed- or vision-name earned at the first raid; an animal+quality byname.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Mel-orotoya (black-mountain), Hippuku-pedsoni (horse-plain); the band named for its deed or its herd; -polis for the tent-cities.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (mounted war-clans of the grass-sea: the war-king and his companion-society over the band-chiefs; the assembly of riders and the mystery-cult raise the war-king)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Hellenic-Plains clanhold, ascending; titles blend the two (Greek toparch/strategos/basileus + Plains nantan/paraibo/naika). Toparnan (lord) barony; Phrourwap (border war-chief) march; Eparaibo (district-chief) county; Strategwa (war-general) duchy; Dynaraibo (great-chief prince) principality; Basinaika (war-king) kingdom; Autoknaika (high war-king) empire. The assembly of riders and the mystery-cult check the war-king. (Rank titles fuse the real Greek/Plains register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: a child-name, replaced at the first raid by a deed- or vision-name; the genolowa (war-band-clan); a Greek -ides patronymic for the high-born; an animal+quality byname.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the war-king and companion-society bear deed-names and Greek honor-styles; others a band-name + vision-name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the sky, sun and war-powers + a fused element: -machos (war), Hipp- (horse), Mel- (black), or a vision-sign: e.g. Maraksios-machos, Hipp-toravios.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Hellenic + Plains), never real Greek/Plains gods. Thracan seeds/shifts Lawful or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met in the mystery-rite and the vision-quest, under the open sky and at the kurgan-tomb; the war-king is initiate and war-leader both.
religion.the_one: Aiterunos (< Aeternus; fused Hellenic Aiternos / Plains Ateruna) - the Sky-Eternal over the grass-sea; revered when Lawful, reviled as the cold tyrant when Chaotic

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toravios (the sun, the just light; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraksios (the war-fire, the raid; Chaotic power)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiterunos) and the Lawful powers (Toravios, Orlantos, Numawios, Gaiantos), demonize the Chaotic powers (Maraksios, Tamawios, Lusantios)
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraksios the war-fire, Tamawios the storm, the raid-frenzy of the mystery-rite), demonize the Lawful powers and the One

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maraksios the War-Fire, Dementus -> Tamawios the Mad-Storm; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Toravios the Cold-Sun, Aeternus -> Aiterunos the Sky-Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Tem-shinato (mystery-precinct and sacred cairn) of [power] on the high ground: 'the Tem-shinato of Maraksios', and the vision-rite of the riders.
religion.saints_pattern: the great war-kings and mystery-initiates who became sky-riders; honored at the kurgan-tomb and the mystery-precinct.

holy_symbol_motifs.Toravios: a radiate sun above a galloping horse
holy_symbol_motifs.Maraksios: a bronze spear and horsetail-standard beneath a thunder-cloud
holy_symbol_motifs.Tamawios: the forked storm over the grass-sea

banks_patterns.ships: (horse-lords of the grass) the war-standards and famed steeds bear names, not ships: 'Storm-Mane', 'the Bronze Lance', 'Wind-Drinker' (a famed horse)
banks_patterns.military_units: the companion-society and the rider-host: the [animal] Hetairoi (companions) / the [chief] riders: 'the Wolf-Companions', 'the Storm-Riders'
banks_patterns.taverns: the wine-tent and the war-feast: 'the Bronze Kylix', 'the Mare's-Milk Tent'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: kurgan barrow-tombs and abandoned tent-polis grounds: 'the Kurgan of [war-king]', 'the Ghost-Camp of [band]'
